records.TT1A/g0/r0: September 25, 1995. It all began that day…
records.TT1A/g0/r1: Newscaster: Late last night, Dr. Simon—the physicist known as a reclusive genius—made a remarkable statement about time travel.
records.TT1A/g0/r2: Simon: Well… after many years of research, I believe I've brought what was once only a fantasy—time travel—much closer to reality…
records.TT1A/g0/r3: The Fortune Service Center presents "Today's Fortune." Please enter your blood type.
records.TT1A/g0/r5: First, we'll begin with a personality test. Please answer each question.
records.TT1A/g0/r6: Do you prefer consommé to miso soup?
records.TT1A/g0/r7: Can you swim at least 50 meters?
records.TT1A/g0/r8: Do you ever burst out laughing for no reason?
records.TT1A/g0/r9: When it comes to baseball, it's gotta be the Giants.
records.TT1A/g0/r10: Have you dated three or more girls?
records.TT1A/g0/r11: Have you ever experienced sleep paralysis?
records.TT1A/g0/r12: Are there at least three people you'd like to punch?
records.TT1A/g0/r13: Have you ever sat alone, hugging your knees, and cried?
records.TT1A/g0/r14: Would you rather not sacrifice your free time for work?
records.TT1A/g0/r15: Do you care about brand names?
records.TT1A/g0/r16: Do you put off until tomorrow what you could do today?
records.TT1A/g0/r17: Do you believe only you can protect yourself?
records.TT1A/g0/r18: Do you want to contribute to society someday?
records.TT1A/g0/r19: Would you rather live a short but full life?
records.TT1A/g0/r23: You avoid conflict—a cool-headed pacifist. You're good at managing information and tend toward the intellectual. You're sociable, but you dislike belonging to organizations. By avoiding close relationships, you often wind up isolated. Even then, you step back and analyze yourself objectively. An unusual personality.
records.TT1A/g0/r24: You're cautious and methodical, so you rarely fail—but you can come across as ordinary. Principled and diligent, you're a serious, stubborn scholar type. You worry so much about other people that you wear yourself out. You're awkward in love, but a romantic at heart.
records.TT1A/g0/r25: Optimistic and easy to like, you're colorful and popular. You throw yourself into whatever interests you, but the moment your heart isn't in it, your motivation vanishes—and careless blunders follow. Your curiosity and sharp intuition make you well suited to journalism.
records.TT1A/g0/r26: You're earnest and passionate, with an eye for the heart of a matter—the politician type. You value honor but have little head for money. Your strong sense of self can easily turn selfish. And you're always dreaming of dramatic romance.
records.TT1A/g0/r27: "Today's Fortune" — Today could become a day you'll never forget. Cool judgment and a strong will will guide you toward good fortune. You'll have a chance encounter at a museum in the suburbs, where a wonderful woman is sure to leap into your arms. Here's the line that'll win her over! And those words are…
records.TT1A/g0/r29: Maradul Barao Garadura… Chant it again and again. Maradul Barao Garadura… Maradul Barao Garadura!
records.TT1A/g0/r30: Time travel, huh… So far, it's all talk. Nobody's ever actually made it work. More importantly…
records.TT1A/g0/r31: ………… Weird… Some kind of magic spell? Whatever… No time like the present!
records.TT1A/g1/r0: We sincerely apologize. The correct phrase is: "When you smile, it's as though the sun rises." Thank you for using our service.
records.TT1A/g1/r1: The 21st century is almost here… but people aren't exactly eager to welcome the new age. Conflict still rages around the world. Environmental destruction and food shortages are growing worse. Anyone can see that Earth's future is full of uncertainty.
records.TT1A/g1/r2: And so, modern people who feel lost have begun turning to fortune-telling for salvation. To make it through these dark times, they need someone to show them the way. And strangely enough, the fortunes come true.
